amends: Issue #110 protocol v1.0.0 without rewriting it
authorization: Does not authorize task selection, AI invocation, candidate generation, empirical collection, or Issue #110 execution.

changes.defect: count lacked clustered, attrition, censoring, conjunctive, or interaction power justification
changes.effect_on_interpretation: prevents an underpowered null from being labeled non-support and separates bounded from general claims
changes.prospective_revision: outcome-blind calibration followed by deterministic Monte Carlo; select smallest eligible design meeting the frozen requirement
changes.scientific_justification: paired executions nested in repositories/tasks are not independent and conjunction power is binding

changes.defect: production clustering, survival, mixed effects, uncertainty, and multiplicity were unresolved
changes.effect_on_interpretation: pooled effects cannot erase heterogeneous domain results
changes.prospective_revision: 10,000-draw paired-template cluster bootstrap, Kaplan-Meier RMST, repository-by-task strata, Holm family correction, and explicit interactions
changes.scientific_justification: matches assignment and censoring while controlling familywise error

changes.defect: candidate timing and implementation-only/configuration checks were incomplete
changes.effect_on_interpretation: failure is INDETERMINATE and never migration support/non-support
changes.prospective_revision: evaluate all four frozen clauses A-D from immutable event fields
changes.scientific_justification: the assigned manipulation must be realized before causal interpretation

changes.defect: baseline, correlation, timing, cluster variation, censoring and attrition were unknown
changes.original_rule: final cohort fixed before nuisance evidence
changes.prospective_revision: permit only labeled external, synthetic, or pre-study outcome-blind calibration and re-run signed engine
changes.scientific_justification: precision depends on nuisance parameters, not desired outcomes

changes.defect: task-template order randomization does not imply exchangeability of whole-repository signs
changes.effect_on_interpretation: p-values target the repository-population symmetry model; inability to justify symmetry blocks inference and final N
changes.original_rule: blocked paired crossover randomizes condition order within repository/task/difficulty blocks
changes.prospective_revision: freeze whole-repository score sign flips only as a separate independent-cluster/joint-symmetry inferential assumption; never label them experiment randomization inference
changes.scientific_justification: preserves arbitrary within-repository dependence while making the additional population-model assumption explicit and falsifiable as a readiness gate
